name.help: Display name for this Gotify communication channel.

server_url.help: Base URL of the Gotify server.

token.help: Gotify application token. Stored encrypted at rest.

title: Gotify notification delivery
subtitle: Plugin-owned
description: This plugin owns the Gotify. It stores Gotify connection settings on the channel itself and dispatches notifications through the plugin runtime.
securityDescription: The Gotify application token is stored encrypted at rest. Use a dedicated application token for McHarbor so it can be rotated independently.
testDescription: The host test action posts a real message to the configured Gotify application. Use a test application first if the token notifies production devices.
secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.

step1.body: Open your Gotify server and create a dedicated application for McHarbor notifications.

step2.body: Copy the application token and paste it into this channel configuration. McHarbor stores it encrypted at rest and redacts it from API responses.

step3.body: Set Server URL to the Gotify base URL, for example https://gotify.example.com, without the /message path.

step4.body: Optionally set Priority as an integer if your Gotify clients use priority-based notification rules.

step5.body: Save the channel and click Test connection. The plugin posts a real test message through the same path used for live workflow, alert, and backup events.

step6.body: If Test fails, verify the server URL, application token, reverse proxy path, and TLS certificate trust.
